newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lucent wins contract with D.Telekom.
newsitem.headline: Lucent wins contract with D.Telekom.

text.p: U.S. telecommunications equipment supplier Lucent Technologies Inc said on Tuesday it won a $30 million contract to provide mobile phone base stations to Deutsche Telekom AG.
Telekom, the former monopoly phone company, would use Lucent base stations and receivers to expand its D1 cellular network over the next 18 months.
Lucent, the former equipment arm of AT&T Corp that was spun off last year, has already supplied 3,000 base stations for Telekom's T-Mobile unit.
The D1 network, with 2.5 million subscribers, is the second largest in Germany behind the D2 service of Mannesmann Mobilfunk GmbH, a unit of Mannesmann AG.
